def: a Corinthian, i.e. inhabitant of Corinth

occurrences.text: And Crispus, the chief ruler of the synagogue, believed on the Lord with all his house; and many of the Corinthians hearing believed, and were baptized.
O ye Corinthians, our mouth is open unto you, our heart is enlarged.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
